objects.name: Analytic 1713
objects.description: For Android, detect Network Denial of Service by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: ConnectivityManager, TelephonyManager, or WifiManager framework callbacks report repeated failure, disable, or oscillation events outside expected coverage-transition pattern]; Protected Configuration via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Maximum span for correlating connectivity degradation, application retry behavior, and network-session failure into a single denial event.
Users or device populations expected to move through low-coverage zones or transit environments that naturally cause network oscillation.
Apps expected to generate frequent retry behavior or maintain persistent sessions under ordinary weak-signal conditions.
Whether impacted applications are expected to be actively visible to the user for the analytic to carry high confidence.
Time threshold for determining whether connectivity degradation occurred during active device use versus idle background operation.
Threshold for repeated disconnects, resets, DNS failures, or transport failures within the correlation window.
Apps or services expected to rely on GPS or network-based location and therefore likely to exhibit secondary degradation during jamming.
Known sites or geographies with weak legitimate coverage that should be baseline-adjusted.
